80580.meaning1: (not) acting in the interest; working for the good (of)
80580.commentary: (DNa) evarūpena kira bho puriso atthacarakenā'ti idaṃ yādiso tvaṃ, edise atthacarake hitakārake sati puriso nirayaṃ'y'eva gaccheyya, na aññatrā'ti imam'atthaṃ sandhāya vadati. (DNt) atthacarakenā'ti iminā byatirekamukhena anatthacarakataṃ'y'eva vibhāveti.
80580.notes: The phrase is said sarcastically, giving the opposite meaning.

examples.text: aho vata re amhākaṃ paṇḍitaka, aho vata re amhākaṃ bahussutaka, aho vata re amhākaṃ tevijjaka, evarūpena kira, bho, puriso atthacarakena kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjeyyā'ti, kupito anattamano ambaṭṭhaṃ māṇavaṃ padasā'y'eva pavattesi.

examples.text: kupito anattamano ambaṭṭhaṃ māṇavaṃ padasā'y'eva pavattesi.
